candidates.title: Move Sign-In after Adoption Selection
candidates.change: Move account sign-in to take place after pet selection so users build connection and motivation before creating an account.
candidates.why: Adoption has a high drop-off (60.9% conversion) and forcing sign-in up front adds friction before users experience pet customization.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in within onboarding is allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Delaying friction until after adoption builds investment, targeting a major drop-off step.

candidates.why: The adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and long decision time (median 89s, mean 1017s), suggesting choice friction.

candidates.title: Free Accessories Badge on Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Add a starter rewards badge on the adoption certificate screen to encourage users to finish pet adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low at 60.9%, needing stronger incentive to finish.

candidates.title: Ready Notification Toggle during Waiting Step

decisions.title: Clear Desktop Spawning Instructions on Home Intro
Live Generation Progress & Tip Carousel on Waiting Screen
Centered Mascot Intro on Story Screen

lessons_next: Reordering the onboarding flow (moving sign-in after adoption selection) was helpful (+5.5%), though the +10.0% prediction was over-optimistic.
Updating intro copy (desktop spawning instructions) showed no clear effect (-0.6%), and the +12.0% prediction was far too high.
Adding progress indicators and tip carousels to the waiting screen showed no clear effect, despite leaning positive (+4.0%, p=0.051).
Layout tweaks (centered mascot intro) provided no benefit (+0.1%) and triggered guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions across all rounds were consistently too high compared to measured results.
